title: Research Assistant / Student Assistant (studentische Hilfskraft)
points: My role included support for continuing MSc thesis research on KV cache compression under Prof. Dr. Volker Schulz. The public JoLT preprint reports near-lossless 2x to 3x compression across five models and four model families: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.12550.

Earlier in the role, I graded weekly Numerical Optimization exercise sheets and gave written feedback on unconstrained and constrained optimization, line search, trust-region methods, KKT conditions, and numerical linear algebra.

title: Software Developer (SDE II)
points: I designed a rule-based, declarative content-matching framework for tax-document field comparison over SAP iFlow, letting country teams configure field comparisons with no custom code. It reduced new-country onboarding from about 10 days to about 3 days and was adopted by the Spain, India, and Chile teams.
I designed an iFlow bulk-retrieval algorithm for the DCC Spain reporting path, replacing about 100 paginated API calls with one bulk request and reducing report generation time by about 30%.

I proposed a per-customer self-correcting ML system for content-matching results, with in-tenant training to avoid central data pooling. I presented the concept at an internal SAP innovation forum in early 2024; it was accepted as a future direction but was not shipped before my role ended.

I was promoted from SDE I to SDE II after consistent top reviews and selected for SAP Labs India's fast-track architect career-development program, as the only person from my area in the program at the time.

title: Associate Software Developer (SDE I)
points: I owned the result-processing pillar of the Document Consistency Cockpit end to end. I designed its schema, decoupling layer, factory-based extensibility, idempotency, and retry semantics. I load-tested it at 10M to 100M document cycles and deployed it for Spain and India.

I initiated and led a Turkey error-handling overhaul for SAP DRC, categorizing two years of incidents by root cause and shipping fixes, clearer messages, and customer-facing FAQs. Incident volume fell about 88%, from roughly 50 to 2 or 3 per month, while the support rating rose from 2 or 3 to 4 or 5 out of 5.

I re-engineered a failing daily Turkey vendor reconciliation job by replacing a timing-out database join with a hash-map lookup keyed on tax ID, eliminating recurring failures as the registered-entity list grew.

I designed GDPR-aligned Data Protection and Privacy compliance for the SAP Document Consistency solution and delivered legal and feature updates across Turkey, Mexico, and Chile. I received the SAP Stellar Award in 2023 for the DCC and Turkey work.

title: Software Engineering Intern
points: I shipped backlog features for the SAP eDocument solution, now SAP DRC, including Turkey delivery-note support and an XML proxy update for upstream format changes.
I delivered consistently ahead of deadline with near-zero QA defects and earned a direct full-time offer on the same team.
